subject: comparing replication versus model-parallel placement of 4 models across 4 GPUs as memory budget scales from 1x to 4x

groups.why_chosen: A GPU x memory-budget grid comparing replication vs model-parallel placement across the same three budget rows, using identical model colours and only labeling the shared row axis once.
groups.what_to_learn: Keep one colour per model across both panels; draw it as a whole tile under replication and subdivide that tile into shards under model parallelism, sharing one 1x/2x/4x row axis across the divider — but identical shard groups go unnoticed.
